description: This PHP source file appears to be part of a SuiteCRM module for managing project tasks. It sets up a list view for the current user's project tasks, applies filters based on task status and start date, and handles layout editing features for administrators.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: Represents the list view component used for displaying a list of project tasks with sorting and filtering.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the filter query for listing project tasks based on assigned user, status, and start date.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Renders the list view for project tasks according to the specified template and seed bean.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title displayed in the list view, including optional layout editing controls.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the list view with a specific HTML template and localization strings.
